privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset contains 25 valid participants (s1-s25) and one invalid participant (s99). Participant s99 must be excluded from group averages but included in the JSON with 'excluded: true'. The analysis must only use trials where 'correct' == 1. The delta plot requires 5 quintiles (Q1-Q5). The final output must be saved to /home/ga/pebl/analysis/simon_report.json.
